translations.web: In the first month, on the fourteenth day of the month in the evening, is Yahweh’s Passover.
translations.bsb: The Passover to the LORD begins at twilight on the fourteenth day of the first month.
translations.kjv: In the fourteenth day of the first month at even is the LORD'S passover.
